headline: 轨迹 climbs from 1,373rd to 63rd on ARC-AGI-3

sections.text: 轨迹 gained 8.58 to reach 33.71, rising from 1,373rd to 63rd on the ARC-AGI-3 public board.
The result puts 轨迹 inside the top 100, while the board’s 18 gold places remain higher up.
